name: mtg-deckbuilder
description: Build, validate and playtest professional-quality MTG decks using only cards you own — three skills: 40-card limited (mtg-deckbuilder), 60-card constructed (mtg-deckbuilder-60) and Commander/EDH (mtg-commander). Parses collection CSV exports, verifies every card via Scryfall (cache-first, never from model memory), enforces format legality and ownership gates, audits functional packages, runs a Monte Carlo goldfish simulator (command-zone and ramp aware), and delivers Moxfield-importable decklists plus a self-contained HTML report.
